input.title: Token Factory watch · Tue Oct 27
input.content:
# Token Factory watch · Tue Oct 27

**One price changed for a role we use.** Nemotron 3 Super (Researcher, Analyst, Writer) goes from $0.30 / $0.90 to **$0.24 / $0.72** per 1M tokens on Oct 29. Ultra and Nano are unchanged; no model was added or removed.

## What it does to our week

| | week's cost | change |
|---|---|---|
| at today's prices | $0.2094 | |
| at the Oct 29 prices | $0.1848 | −11.7 % |
| plus the proposed rule | $0.1688 | −19.4 % in all |

## Proposed router rule

Run the **Analyst's third hop and every later one on Nano**. Those hops read results and report; the first two (the first look at the data and the fix to the first attempt) stay on Super. In the usage export, 9 hops across the workstreams are Analyst hops from the third on that the router sent to Super.

*If applied: −19.4 %.* This is an estimate from one week of mock-model usage. It also trades some judgment in the Analyst's later reports for cost: run `pnpm eval:ab --cheap` before and after.

Approving records the rule in `data/router-rules.json`; the router applies it from the next run, and each routed hop says so in its route reason.
